summary: Frontend-only verification of the enhanced Reports tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/reports.tsx). All 4 additive UI elements render correctly on 390x844 viewport: (1) KPI strip with 4 cells (Revenue ₹18.4L, Expenses ₹14.2L, Net Profit ₹4.2L, GST 9/12) each with colored dot; (2) per-card headline metrics/pills — Financial 'Net ₹4.2L +12%', Compliance '9/12 · 3 pending', Audit Trail '14 unreconciled', AI Insights 'Next ₹4.6L +8%'; (3) 4 'View details' footers (one per card); (4) 'More Reports' grid with 5 tiles. All 4 SectionCard header/footer taps AND all 5 More-Reports tiles navigate to real screens with 0 'Unmatched Route' occurrences. All 4 existing charts (InteractiveLineChart, GSTGauge, AuditProgressBar, LogLineChart) still render. Backend testing skipped per request.

issues: 'Cash Register' tile label truncates to 'Cash Regi…' at 390px viewport (moreTile width '48%' minus icon+chevron leaves ~140px for label). Consider reducing horizontal padding or moreIcon size, or allowing 2-line label, or shortening to 'Cash Reg.'

action_items: OPTIONAL/POLISH: Fix 'Cash Register' tile label truncation on ~390px screens (see design_issues). Non-blocking.
OPTIONAL: Add testID to each More-Reports tile and each SectionCard footer for future regression stability (e.g., tile-cash-register, card-financial-viewdetails).
critical_code_review_comments: reports.tsx is 1071 lines and >700-line guideline threshold. Consider extracting the 4 chart components (LogLineChart, InteractiveLineChart, GSTGauge, AuditProgressBar) and SectionCard into /src/components/reports/ for maintainability (not required for this task; charts are unchanged).

KPI strip values, per-card metrics, trend pill %s, and 'More Reports' tiles are all hard-coded literals in reports.tsx. They will not react to the real financial data returned by getFinancialData(). If these must reflect live/mock data, wire them from MOCK_REPORTS or the API result — currently they are visual-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding is session-scoped via a module-level flag in app/_layout.tsx (_onboardingShownThisSession); every full page reload re-triggers /onboarding. To reach any deep link in tests: goto '/', set localStorage.auth_token, reload, tap 'Skip', then navigate in-app via router.push (click links/tiles) and use page.go_back() to return. Direct page.goto('/reports/financial') will bounce to /onboarding. Bottom tabs have no testIDs — use page.get_by_text('Reports').last for the Reports tab.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found. All 9 navigation targets resolve to their intended routes with 0 'Unmatched Route' hits: /reports/financial, /reports/compliance, /reports/audit-trail, /reports/ai-insights, /reports/gst, /reports/einvoice-list, /reports/ewb-list, /kpi/cash-register, /daybook.
